name: Hulking Warbit
description: Brings both axe heads across the body in an X cut that opens the guard before the second blow lands.

name: Rutting Warbeard
description: Hooks the lower beard of one axe behind a limb and pulls while the other axe waits above.

name: Sturdiest Haftcap
description: Crosses both hafts over the head and braces the legs to take a heavy blow without giving ground.

name: Stampeding Brunt
description: Drops one axe and then the other in a steady heavy beat that grinds a guard down.

name: Horned Crescentbit
description: Sets one axe in the guard and drives the second through the same cut to split it open.

name: Trampling Battercut
description: Turns the back to the foe and swings both axes around together into the exposed side of the guard.

name: Bellowing Hewdown
description: Locks the heads of both axes over an enemy weapon and wrenches it out of the grip.

name: Lumbering Battleheel
description: Walks forward with both axes raised at the shoulder and turns blows aside with the beards while closing the distance.

name: Titanous Smite
description: Lifts both axes high and brings them down together with the full body behind them to break ground and guard alike.

name: Behemoth Warcleave
description: Sweeps both axes low and wide in one turn to cut down a whole rank of attackers.

name: Bullnecked Bitedge
description: Catches an incoming blow between crossed bits and turns it back along the same line into the attacker.

name: Massive Warpoll
description: Brings both axes down in one measured stroke that carries the whole body and is spent to the limit of the reserve.

name: Unyoked Rive
description: Gathers the whole reserve into both axes and fells everything in front of the wielder to the destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Ironhide Brunt
description: Drives both bits into the earth and tears it open outward to the destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Pawing Battleheel
description: Carries both axes low at the hips in a wide stance and steps forward without lifting the heels.

name: Hooved Warbeard
description: Drops one axe straight down from above the shoulder with the beard leading while the other stays guarded.

name: Snorting Warpoll
description: Turns the axe in the hand and raps with the back of the head to stun a reaching arm.

name: Thickset Haftcap
description: Crosses both hafts in front of the chest to stop a swing before it gathers speed.

name: Wallowing Battercut
description: Chains chops from left axe and right axe in a heavy even rhythm that never gives the foe a turn.

name: Bullish Warbit
description: Catches the beard of an axe over a wrist and drags the arm down and out of line.

name: Rutting Bitedge
description: Drives both axe edges into the same point of a barred door or shield until it gives.

name: Beefy Banded
description: Advances behind both raised axe heads so that blows land on the steel and not the body.

name: Shaggy Crescentbit
description: Falls with both axes on the rim of a shield and cleaves through it into what stands behind.

name: Hulking Rive
description: Cuts a wide low arc with both axes that gouges the ground and drives back everyone at the edge.

name: Trampling Smite
description: Raises both axe heads and brings them down together to break a guard and the bones behind it.

name: Hulking Wideeye
description: Plants the feet and brings both axes down in one stroke that holds all the weight the body can lend.

name: Hooved Chock
description: Snaps a hand axe down from the wrist onto an arm or hand that reaches in.

name: Rutting Billet
description: Keeps the elbow tucked to the ribs and cuts short and hard with the axe at close range.

name: Thickset Beard
description: Checks an incoming edge with the beard of one hand axe while the other axe prepares to answer.

name: Wallowing Kerf
description: Throws a fast run of short cuts from one hand axe and then the other without pause.

name: Bullish Helve
description: Hooks a beard behind a knee or an ankle and drags the foe off balance while the second axe cuts.

name: Snorting Splinter
description: Chops at both knees with a hand axe on each side to bring a taller foe down.

name: Pawing Heel
description: Pivots under the rim of a raised shield and chops at the legs and belt beneath it.

name: Horned Eye
description: Works the bits of both axes into a seam in the armor and pries it wide open.

name: Bullnecked Axehew
description: Crosses both hand axes over a weapon arm and pins it against the foe's own body.

name: Trampling Fell
description: Spins forward with a hand axe in each fist and chops at every opening that turns past.

name: Massive Haftswell
description: Crosses the pair of hand axes inward in one close cut that carries the full weight of the shoulders.

name: Hulking Hammerface
description: Jabs the spiked poll of the hammer short and straight into a gap in the foe's guard.

name: Lumbering Faceplate
description: Swings the flat face of the hammer from overhead down onto a raised guard or helm.

name: Horned Cheekplate
description: Holds the haft across the body in both hands to stop a swing at the wrist and elbow.

name: Bellowing Hammerblow
description: Lifts the hammer from low behind the hip and smashes it up and under an armored chin.

name: Shaggy Clawside
description: Hooks the spike behind a leg and drags the foe down onto the ground.

name: Sturdiest Anvilback
description: Braces the haft against the body and leans on a pinned shield or weapon until the foe tires.

name: Bullnecked Beakpick
description: Drives the spike through a chest plate with the weight of the whole swing behind it.

name: Stampeding Peenbite
description: Sweeps the hammer wide at chest height and cracks armor along a whole line of foes.

name: Titanous Hammerneck
description: Raises the hammer and brings it down so that the shock goes through plate and padding into the bone.

name: Behemoth Drivehome
description: Sets the feet and delivers one hammer stroke that spends all the weight the body and the reserve can give.
